    MIN(sale_date) as min_date,
    MAX(sale_date) as max_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_records,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel_code = 'WB' THEN 1 END) as web_flag_exists
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-11-03'

FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date >= '2025-11-03'

SELECT 
    p.product_key,
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as web_sales_net,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
  AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY p.product_key, p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY web_sales_net DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) as web_sales_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-11-03'
  AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY web_sales_gross DESC
LIMIT 10
